title: Craft a Pressure Suit
briefing: A pressure suit is the difference between a dive and a death sentence. Craft or recover any diving-rated suit before pushing deeper.
fieldGuide: Deep Reach crafting checkpoint: prove the player can assemble pressure gear.

objectives.label: Obtain a Diving Suit
objectives.detail: Use a shoal suit or any equivalent diving suit from ECHO equipment.

rewards.label: Dive Tool
rewards.detail: Basic underwater cutting and prying tool.

rewards.label: Light Sensor
rewards.detail: Portable photic sensor for mapping dark zones.

completionText: Pressure suit and basic dive tools ready. The twilight zone is now within reach.
